title:
Wrapper for Microbench type.

This type does a couple things on top of what Microbench already does:

1. Adds a 'c3ui.' prefix to the name when reporting in Microbench
2. Reports the results to Prometheus for visualization in Grafana via the UiPerformanceKpi
App.Meter. See the Test KPIs dashboald here: https://c3ui.c3ci.cloud/grafana/d/L5GUXnZNk/test-kpis
name: UiMicrobench
